requirements.statement: Measure real idle host CPU before setting a regression budget or changing waits; preserve queue and latency contracts.
Cache trusted git resolution per process without caching caller repository exclusions or doing import-time I/O.
Retain the project host lock through history writer drain and final settlement before acknowledging stopped.
Diagnose claim and crash-loop timing flakes and tolerate an already-exited enumerated host without weakening existing guarantees.
